blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Arresting Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who has been ordered arrested by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for being a co-perpetrator in former President Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, could lead to 10,000 deaths. Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla made this claim on Tuesday. Remulla said that this was the reason the government was negotiating for the surrender of Senator “Bato” Dela Rosa. The Interior Secretary said this at the sidelines of the 20th Asean Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crime in Makati City.
